title: Run card cells and the allowed-command rule
description: The Run card's cells are DERIVED by the controller from the rehearsal record sent at session creation; the browser never sends a command. DERIVATION: cell `install` = route.install[].cmd joined with ' && ' (kind install, timeoutSec 600); one cell per route.steps[] (kind step, cellId = step id, cmd = step cmd, timeoutSec = limits.step_timeout(step.timeoutSec)); a last cell `knobs` (kind knobs) whose cmd is knobsVerified[0].cmd. Each cell carries `expected`, built from the record only: the step's measured sec, the metric_decreased/metric_below first and last values, the files the step produced (path, bytes), and stdoutHead/stdoutTail when the record has them. ALLOWED COMMAND (the whole v1 security rule beyond the sandbox): a run request names a cellId and may carry `flags` only for the flags listed in that cell's `flags` with editable true (for `knobs`: the route.knobs entries of the final step that appear in knobsVerified[0].cmd). The controller builds the command by REPLACING those flags' values in the cell's cmd (runner.set_flag) and shell-quoting each value; any other flag, any unknown cellId, any value failing its type rule is refused with 400 and a message naming the flag and the rule. TYPE RULES: float must match ^-?[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ (an int-looking value for a float knob is refused: the repository's configurator type-checks, so write 0.5, 1.0); int ^-?[0-9]+$; bool true|false|True|False; string ^[A-Za-z0-9 :,.'_-]{0,80}$ and must not contain '='. No arbitrary shell, no free command field.

value.description: the value in the cell's current command (what the record's run used)

expected.description: what the rehearsal produced for this cell, to compare against; every field comes from the record

cmd.description: display command with the record's flag values
